title: How to see your grade breakdown in Canvas
steps: Open Canvas and click the course from your Dashboard.
In the course menu on the left, click Grades.
Scroll the list to see your score on each assignment.
Look at the sidebar for your total and how each assignment group is weighted.

check.question: Which link in the course menu do you click first?

title: How to test a "What-If" grade in Canvas
steps: Open the course and click Grades.
Click the score (or the dash) next to an assignment.
Type the score you think you might get and press Enter.
Check your total: it updates to show the What-If grade.
Click the arrow next to the score to put the real one back.

check.question: What do you click to enter a What-If score?

title: How to choose which Canvas notifications you get
steps: Click Account in the dark menu on the far left.
Click Notifications.
Find a type, such as Due Date or Announcement.
Click the icon next to it and pick: right away, daily summary, weekly summary, or off.

check.question: Where do you start to change notifications?

title: How to submit an assignment in Canvas
steps: Open the course and click Assignments.
Click the name of the assignment.
Click Start Assignment.
Upload your file, or type or paste your work, depending on what the instructor allows.
Click Submit Assignment and look for the "Submitted" confirmation.

check.question: Which button do you click to begin your submission?

title: How to read your instructor's feedback in Canvas
steps: Open the course and click Grades.
Click the name of the assignment.
Read the comments shown with your submission.
If there is a rubric, click to view it and see how each row was scored.

check.question: Where do you find feedback on a graded assignment?
choices: Under Grades, by clicking the assignment

title: How to see every due date in the Canvas Calendar
steps: Click Calendar in the dark menu on the far left.
Check the list of courses on the right and tick the ones you want to see.
Switch between Week, Month and Agenda at the top.
Click any item to open the assignment.

check.question: Which Calendar view shows your upcoming items as a list?

title: How to message your instructor in Canvas
steps: Click Inbox in the dark menu on the far left.
Click the compose (pencil) icon.
Choose the course.
Click the address-book icon next to To, then pick Teachers and your instructor.
Write a subject and message, then click Send.

check.question: Which Canvas tool do you use to send the message?

title: How to choose which courses show on your Canvas Dashboard
steps: Click Courses in the dark menu on the far left.
Click All Courses.
Click the star next to each course you want on your Dashboard.
Go back to the Dashboard: only starred courses are shown.

check.question: What do you click next to a course to add it to your Dashboard?

title: How to find your class schedule in Wolverine Access
steps: Go to Wolverine Access and log in with your uniqname.
Open Student Business.
Choose the Backpack/Registration tile.
Pick the term to see your enrolled classes with times and locations.

check.question: Which section of Wolverine Access do you open after logging in?

title: How to view your unofficial transcript in Wolverine Access
steps: Log in to Wolverine Access and open Student Business.
Open the Student Center.
Under Academics, choose View Unofficial Transcript.
Read it on screen, or use your browser's print option to save a PDF.

check.question: Under which heading is the unofficial transcript link?

title: How to find your registration appointment in Wolverine Access
steps: Log in to Wolverine Access and open Student Business.
Choose Backpack/Registration.
Pick the upcoming term.
Look for Enrollment Appointment: it shows the date and time you can start registering.

check.question: What is the date and time you can start registering called?

title: How to save classes in your Backpack before registration
steps: Log in to Wolverine Access and open Student Business.
Choose Backpack/Registration and pick the term.
Search for a class by subject and number.
Select the section you want and add it to your Backpack.
When your appointment opens, register straight from the Backpack.

check.question: Where do you save classes ahead of your registration time?

title: How to check what you owe in Wolverine Access
steps: Log in to Wolverine Access and open Student Business.
Open the Student Center.
Under Finances, open your account inquiry.
Review the charges, payments and the amount due.

check.question: Under which heading do you find your account balance?

title: How to update your address and emergency contact in Wolverine Access
steps: Log in to Wolverine Access and open Student Business.
Open Campus Personal Information.
Choose Addresses or Emergency Contacts.
Edit the entry and click Save.

check.question: Which page holds your address and emergency contacts?

title: How to view your financial aid award in Wolverine Access
steps: Log in to Wolverine Access and open Student Business.
Open the Student Center.
Under Finances, choose View Financial Aid.
Pick the aid year to see each award and its amount.

check.question: What do you pick to see your awards for a given year?
